insights.summary: The agent performed a solid optimization task, focusing on memory allocation patterns. It successfully implemented changes in the core FlashInfer backend and supporting test utilities, following a methodical plan.
strengths: Very fast identification of optimization targets using Grep.
High adherence to the specific iteration-count constraints.
Correct handling of indptr boundary conditions.
weaknesses: Benchmark script was slightly generic and couldn't run in the provided environment.
Did not attempt to optimize kernel parameters beyond memory allocation.
